title: Pseudocode amasung Flowchart
learningObjectives: Algorithm-gi step-sing adu simple amadi porhanaba yamna fajei haiba oina puthokpa language-neutral method adu Pseudocode haibani, khangba.
Executable Code iraba matam mamangda solution plan touba, discuss touba, test touba amasung improve touba-da Pseudocode-gi role khangba.
Algorithm, Pseudocode, Flowchart amasung Program-gi marakta leiba difference amasung relation khangba.
Solution iraba mamangda goal, Input, expected Output, assumption amasung limit-sing khangba.
Instruction-sing adu logic order-da thamna, meaning leiba ming-sing sijinnaba.
START, INPUT, OUTPUT, SET, IF, ELSE, WHILE, FOR amasung STOP keywords achumba oina sijinnaba.
Input louba, achumba order-da calculation touba amasung result utpa Pseudocode iraba.
IF/ELSE sijinnana condition amasung possible result khudingmakki action utpa.
WHILE/FOR sijinnana repeat touba amasung Loop control touba condition khangba.
Starting value, variable update amasung stopping condition khangduna infinite Loop thok-hanba.
Example Input-sing sijinnana Pseudocode adu hand trace touba amasung step khudingmakta value amasung decision record touba.
Unclear instruction, missing step, inconsistent name amasung wrong block order khangduna correct touba.
Flowchart amasung symbol/arrow-gi meaning khangba.
Start/End, Process, Input/Output, Decision amasung Arrow symbol khangba.
Start dagi End phaoba achumba order leiba Flowchart semba nattraga porhanaba.
Decision Diamond amasung Yes/No branch utpa.
Loop-gi return path amasung exit path utpa.
Pseudocode adu Flowchart-da amasung Flowchart adu Pseudocode-da convert touba.
Reader nattraga task-gi matamda Pseudocode nattraga Flowchart karamba clear oiba khangduna khanba.
Representation ani-da same logic, branch, Loop ending amasung expected result leibra check touba.

understand.concept: Pseudocode asi Algorithm-gi khonjel amasung step-sing adu ngangba yade, paojel yamna fajei haibagi matamda sijinnaba khudamni. Mahak asi Python nattraga JavaScript-gumba programming language amagi syntax-da yengba natte. Flowchart-na aduga mathou adu shape amasung arrow-singna mapan-da utli.
understand.whyItMatters: Pseudocode-na syntax-gi maramda khanba nattana logic-da mateng pang-i. Flowchart-na step-gi order, decision branch-sing amasung loop amuk hallakpa lambi utli.

explain.narrative: Pseudocode asi Algorithm-gi khonjel amasung step-sing adu ngangba yade, paojel yamna fajei haibagi matamda sijinnaba khudamni. Mahak asi Python nattraga JavaScript-gumba programming language amagi syntax-da yengba natte. Flowchart-na aduga mathou adu shape amasung arrow-singna mapan-da utli.

examples.code:
Khudam: Pseudocode amasung simple Flowchart
Achumba problem ama khangdok-u
Step-sing matik chumna tharak-u
Result check tou-u
examples.explanation: Asi khudam adu khanghanaba matamgi mapanna sijinnaba oina tou-i; pumnamak executable program natte. Ahambada problem khanghanaba, step-sing order-da iraba amasung result check touba mateng pang-i.
examples.expectedOutput: Achumba step-sing amasung khangba ngamhanba result.

examples.code:
START
INPUT number
IF number MOD 2 = 0 THEN
  OUTPUT "even (nappi)"
ELSE
  OUTPUT "odd (nappi nattaba)"
END IF
STOP
examples.explanation: IF-na condition ama test tou-i. Branch ani-gi marakta ama khaktagi matung in-i. Remainder zero oirabadi Even, nattabadi Odd branch khang-i.
examples.expectedOutput: 7 piba matamda odd; 12 piba matamda even.

examples.code:
START
SET count = 1
WHILE count <= 3
  OUTPUT count
  SET count = count + 1
END WHILE
STOP
examples.explanation: Loop houba matamda makha count-da starting value ama pi-i amasung Loop manungda value adu hen-gat-han-i. count 4 oirabada condition false oiraga Loop loire. Update nattabadi progress leire.

examples.code:
(Oval) Houba → (Parallelogram) Mark pithok-u → (Diamond) Mark >= 40 oibra?
Hoi → (Parallelogram) Pass → (Oval) Loi
Natte → (Parallelogram) Amuk yeng-u → (Oval) Loi
examples.explanation: Oval-na Start/End, Parallelogram-na Input/Output, Diamond-na Decision amasung arrow-na direction utli. Decision branch ani khudingmakki next step amasung end adu clear oigadabani.
examples.expectedOutput: 65 oirabadi Hoi path-ta Pass; 32 oirabadi Natte path-ta amuk yeng-u.

practise.guidedTask: Number ani louba amasung makhoigi sum utpa Pseudocode irou. Matungda Start, Input, Process, Output amasung End leiba Flowchart semjou.
practise.independentTask: Number ama Positive, Negative nattraga Zero oibra khanghanba solution ama semjou. Pseudocode irou, Yes/No branch leiba Flowchart semjou amasung case humni check tou.
hints: Ahanba-da goal, Input amasung expected Output haibadu khangjou.
Instruction khudingmakta khudongchaba action ama thamjou.
Normal step-singda Sequence, decision-da IF/ELSE, repeat-da WHILE/FOR sijinnou.
Flowchart symbol-sing makhoigi achumba meaning matung-inna khallou.
Loop khudingmakki return path amasung exit path check tou.
